verdict.rationale: Mixpanel explicitly positions Session Replay as the way to 'quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off' and lets teams save replay playlists filtered by specific events or properties, which directly supports the PM workflow of moving from a funnel drop-off (an event-based filter) to the replays of affected users. However, the evidence never shows a concrete UI screenshot or explicit 'click from funnel chart to replay' walkthrough, nor specific handling of 'error events' as a trigger. Missing for 10: a documented direct UI action linking a funnel drop-off/error event to a filtered replay list, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific cross-navigation.
